# wso2is_server_configuration (Resource)

Manages the tenant-wide session and provisioning settings. In the Console, these settings are under **Login & Registration > Session** and in the resident identity provider. The resource only changes the settings that you set. Other settings keep their current values. When you destroy this resource, the settings keep their current values, and Terraform stops managing them. Each tenant (or organization) has one set of these settings. To import them, use the ID `server_configuration`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_server_configuration" "this" {
  idle_session_timeout           = 30
  remember_me_period             = 10080
  enable_maximum_session_timeout = true
  maximum_session_timeout        = 1440
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enable_maximum_session_timeout` (Boolean) End sessions after `maximum_session_timeout` regardless of activity.
- `home_realm_identifiers` (List of String) Home realm identifiers of the resident identity provider.
- `idle_session_timeout` (Number) Idle session timeout, in minutes.
- `maximum_session_timeout` (Number) Maximum session lifetime, in minutes.
- `preserve_current_session_at_password_update` (Boolean) Keep the current session when the user changes their password (other sessions end).
- `remember_me_period` (Number) How long *Remember me* keeps users signed in, in minutes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `server_configuration`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_server_configuration.this server_configuration
```
